correctness.rationale: Rational upper cuts determine the larger binary fiber mass, including the endpoint 1/2. Every changed coordinate under singleton agreement must be complemented, and normalization forces its changed-coordinate set to carry half its cardinality in mass. This allows exactly two changes, a swap, or none; the degenerate swaps between Dirac measures are in one class. These swaps preserve every binary cut. The coefficients of the distinct degree-two sign characters in the squared cut profile are twice the off-diagonal products, and normalization recovers the constant coefficient from those products. Stars and bars minus the disjoint Dirac and unequal swap identifications gives the stated denominator-grid count, including n=1 and d=1. The omitted-coordinate witness works for each n>=3; complementation gives the n=2 exception. Sharpness is only within the family of singleton probes. An independent integer replay, `python3 /workspace/branches/independent_replay.py 4`, checked the product/singleton partition and census on 48 grids (4,998 distributions); the real-simplex statement rests on the proof.
